scope: same-user real sudo; no package installation or credential handling
probe_source:
import os,fcntl,time,signal
p=os.fork()
if p==0:
 fcntl.fcntl(0,fcntl.F_SETFL,fcntl.fcntl(0,fcntl.F_GETFL)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
 try: os.read(0,1)
 except BlockingIOError: pass
 os._exit(0)
end=time.monotonic()+3
while time.monotonic()<end:
 found,status=os.waitpid(p,os.WNOHANG)
 if found:
  print("CHILD_FINISHED",status,flush=True);break
 time.sleep(.05)
else:
 print(open('/proc/%d/status'%p).read().splitlines()[2],flush=True)
 print("CHILD_STOPPED_OR_STUCK",flush=True)
 os.kill(p,signal.SIGKILL);os.waitpid(p,0)
attribution: The original terminal-input/piped-output arrangement reproducibly stops a child; this alone does not prove upstream issue #1598 is the exact underlying defect.
